source.attribution: Ron Ross and Victoria Pillitteri (NIST). Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations. Republished courtesy of the National Institute of Standards and Technology. Inspection only; no text redistributed.

rights_screen.statement: Publication may be used voluntarily by nongovernmental organizations; not subject to copyright in the United States; attribution appreciated.
rights_screen.authorship: Ron Ross and Victoria Pillitteri, NIST
rights_screen.method: Whole extracted-text keyword/quotation scan and context checks; authority/prose/table/change-log visual spot checks. Not a line-by-line visual review of all pages.
rights_screen.third_party_screen: No restrictive credit or reproduced third-party figure identified by the screen; no figures listed in table of contents. Incorporated references not downloaded or independently licensed.
rights_screen.recommendation: Preferred identifier/prose candidate for independent review and later owner admission decision; no current admission or worldwide redistribution clearance.
rights_screen.caveat: NIST publication statement and employee authorship are strong evidence, not a blanket license for separately copyrighted incorporated material or an owner decision.

table_column_flattening.observation: Control-ID column precedes description column, then tailoring and requirement columns. Visual row associations are not preserved as a row structure.

zero_padded_control_probe.caveat: Source uses zero padding; absence of AC-2(4) is not proof that this control is absent.

prose_split_witness.observation: ID/title and final account-monitoring clause are in different baseline chunks; no retrieval run or gold span created.

source.title: Application Container Security Guide
source.attribution: Murugiah Souppaya (NIST), John Morello (Twistlock), Karen Scarfone (Scarfone Cybersecurity). Application Container Security Guide. Republished courtesy of the National Institute of Standards and Technology. Inspection only; no text redistributed.

rights_screen.statement: Publication may be used voluntarily by nongovernmental organizations; not subject to copyright in the United States; attribution appreciated.
rights_screen.authorship: Murugiah Souppaya (NIST), John Morello (Twistlock), Karen Scarfone (Scarfone Cybersecurity), verified on physical page 2.
rights_screen.method: Whole extracted-text keyword/quotation scan and context checks; visually inspected authorship, authority, all three listed figures and two table pages.
rights_screen.third_party_screen: No separate external copyright, reproduction or image-credit notice visible on reviewed figure pages 6, 17, 20. NIST SP 800-125 definition quoted on physical page 15; cited source not fetched or independently cleared. Trademark notice on physical page 5 recorded as such, not treated as a license.
rights_screen.recommendation: Retain local_only and seek independent mixed-authorship/incorporation assessment before owner admission. Useful semantic prose candidate, but not a visually complete or clean-text corpus.
rights_screen.caveat: Specific US publication statement is positive evidence; mixed authorship alone does not invalidate it. No affirmative worldwide third-party clearance inferred.

quality_findings.rotated_margin_observation: Spaced and misordered margin-notice characters retained on physical pages 3-63. Contains no Cf/Cc, so zero format-character counts do not mean clean text.

table_review.observation: Some table rows serialize usefully, but line wrapping can split identifiers (e.g. AC- 22), whitespace erases column structure and baseline chunks do not certify row relationships.

decision: INSPECTION_COMPLETE; independent review and owner admission pending; no real labels
